T: Hot day in LA. Cold fish on the table.
D: A private eye hired to follow a cheating husband uncovers a scheme over Los Angeles water.
P: Serve the fish when Noah Cross insists it comes with the head on.
S: Sliced orange, shaved fennel, red onion, black olives and mint
Orange segments with shaved fennel, red onion, black olives and mint, dressed with olive oil and flaky salt.
Crisp rolls of pork mince, cabbage and carrot seasoned with soy

Pork, cabbage and carrot rolled in spring roll wrappers, fried crisp, with sweet chilli and soy for dipping. Fry 300g pork mince until browned, then add 2 cups shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot and cook until soft, seasoning with soy. Roll tablespoons into 16 spring roll wrappers, seal with water and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until crisp. Serve with sweet chilli sauce and soy.
fish seared hard and sliced thin on toasted baguette, lemon aioli, fried capers and dill

Tuna seared hard and sliced thin over toasted baguette with lemon aioli, finished with fried capers, dill and cracked pepper. Slice 1 baguette into 20 rounds, brush with oil and toast at 200C for 8 minutes. Rub a 400g tuna steak with oil, salt and pepper and sear in a smoking pan for 1 minute a side, leaving the middle raw. Rest and slice thin. Mix 100g mayo with lemon zest, lemon juice and a crushed garlic clove. Fry 2 tbsp drained capers in 2 tbsp oil until crisp. Spread toasts with aioli, top with tuna, capers and dill.
M: Whole snapper stuffed with lemon, parsley and garlic
Whole snapper scored, stuffed with lemon and herbs, grilled until the skin blisters and served head and all.
LA French dip with hot jus

Thin-sliced roast beef piled into crusty rolls with melted Swiss cheese, served with a cup of hot beef jus for dipping and hot English mustard. Heat the oven to 200C. Season a 1kg beef topside and roast 45 minutes for medium rare, rest 15 minutes and slice very thin. Deglaze the tray with 100ml red wine, add 600ml beef stock, 1 sliced onion and thyme and simmer 15 minutes, then strain. Split 4 long crusty rolls, dip the cut sides in the jus, pile in the beef, add 2 slices Swiss cheese each and grill until melted. Serve with cups of hot jus and mustard.
W: Tall, light orange sponge made with zest and juice

Light chiffon sponge flavoured with orange zest and juice, baked in a tube tin and glazed with orange icing. Whisk 5 egg yolks with 125ml oil, 125ml orange juice, the zest of 2 oranges, 150g sugar and 200g self-raising flour. Whisk 5 egg whites stiff with 50g sugar and fold in. Bake in an ungreased tube tin at 165C for 50 minutes, cool upside down and glaze with 150g icing sugar mixed with orange juice.
K: Bourbon muddled with orange, mint and brown sugar syrup

Fresh orange and lemon muddled with mint and brown sugar syrup, shaken with bourbon and poured over crushed ice with an orange wheel. Cut 2 oranges into small wedges. For each drink, muddle 3 orange wedges, 4 mint leaves and 15ml brown sugar syrup in a shaker. Add 50ml bourbon, 15ml lemon juice and ice and shake hard for 10 seconds. Strain over crushed ice in a rocks glass and garnish with an orange wheel and a mint sprig. For non-drinkers, swap the bourbon for 80ml fresh orange juice topped with soda.
